faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 23 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (on the date of application). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month + 8% HRA with GATE/NET; Rs. 30,000 per month + 8% HRA without GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: M.E./MTech (specialization in Artificial Intelligence/Electronics/Communications/Electrical/Computer Science) or any related degrees with GATE/NET qualified. Desirable: experience in Cloud Computing/IoT/Software Design/Computer Vision/Artificial Intelligence.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates already in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Offline interview. Offline interview on 27-11-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contract basis. Duration of engagement upto 07.08.2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Civil Engineering, NIT Calicut.
